visual_review.scope: comparison.png plus all six original PNGs viewed with original detail by root, before reading worker conclusion
visual_review.finding: No follow-up character/line ROI selected on either surface. Ensembles contain broad cloudy patches, small bright specks and border bands; 3144 lower-right distortion corresponds to the CT tear/void shape. No uniquely identifiable sequence of independent letter strokes or text lines.
visual_review.limits: Does not prove absence of ink. CT sheet identity, missing-chunk influence and training exposure remain unresolved. Existing maps are publisher contributions, not our ink detection method.
